name: Persistent Postural Perceptual Dizziness (PPPD or 3PD)

category.name: Ears, General
category.part: AME Physical Examination Information and Disposition Tables

what_to_bring: After the condition has fully resolved;
No symptoms remain; and
Medication is no longer needed for suppression of the vertigo:
A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with the treating otolaryngologist (ENT) or neurotologist no more than 90 days prior to the AME exam. It must include:
Current medications, dosage, and side effects (if any);
Physical exam findings;
Results of any testing performed;
Diagnosis;
Assessment and plan (prognosis); and
Follow-up
It must specifically include:
If in remission, when did remission commence.
Current clinical audiogram with Air- Conduction/Bone- Conduction (AC/BC) and Speech Discriminat ion (SD) (performed within the past 90 days).
Additional tests such as [ECOG, VEMP, MRI with Gadolinium of the cerebellopontine angle (CPA), etc.] performed as clinically indicated.
All Office treatment records.
Pharmacy Records for the last 3 years from all Pharmacies used.
Copies of any Vestibular Rehab progress notes (if performed).
